meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作短小精悍的动态图形视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成动效字幕、数据图表或品牌动画
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate kinetic typography, data charts, or brand animations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述，自动生成一段短动画（如文字动效、数据图表、地图动画等），输出 MP4 或透明叠加视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一段短动画（通常 10 秒内，最长约 30 秒），且不需要旁白或真人拍摄时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个公司 Logo 的出场动画。
say.note: Claude 会生成 logo 动画并输出视频。

say.text: 把这段文字做成动态排版效果。
用这个数据生成一个柱状图动画。
say.note: Claude 会生成数据可视化动画。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate a short motion graphic (e.g., kinetic typography, data chart, map animation) based on your description, outputting MP4 or transparent overlay video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short motion graphic (usually under 10s, up to ~30s) without narration or live-action subjects.

say_en.text: Create a logo reveal animation for my company.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a logo sting video.

say_en.text: Turn this text into kinetic typography.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a kinetic type animation.

say_en.text: Animate this data as a bar chart.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a data visualization animation.
